programme.title: The Big Bang Theory

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory

programme.title: Scandal
programme.desc: 1989. Drama. Director: Michael Caton-Jones. Stars John Hurt, Joanne Whalley & Bridget Fonda. An affair between an exotic dancer and the Minister of War shakes up the British government.

programme.title: Dying to be Beautiful
programme.desc: Lolo Ferrari, the French model and actress sensationalised for her extreme physical transformation. This documentary reveals the vulnerable woman behind the fame and record breaking surgeries.

programme.title: EuroTrash
programme.desc: 1994. Hosted by Antoine de Caunes and Jean Paul Gaultier. On the anniversary of French pop icon Claude Francois death, visit his grave with his fans and an interview with 'The Claudettes'.

programme.title: The Hot Month of August
programme.desc: 1966. Drama. Director: Sokrates Kapsaskis & Dorris Wishman. Stars Petros Fyssoun, Giannis Fertis & Minas Christidis. A chance encounter with two women leaves Jason framed in a crime of passion.

programme.title: A Saint, A Woman, A Devil
programme.desc: 1977. Drama. Director: Peter Savage. Stars Joanna Bell, Marc Stevens & Sonny Landham. Sylvia is a seemingly quiet and saintly person. But she is hiding a promiscuous multiple personality disorder.

programme.title: Circumstantial Evidence (1952)
programme.desc: 1952. Crime. Director: Daniel Birt. Stars: Rona Anderson, Patrick Holt & John Arnatt. Cleverly crafted crime drama - A woman seeks evidence that will give her grounds for divorce.

programme.title: Look At Life Members Only
programme.desc: 1962. This film takes a visit to London's clubland, from the smoky rooms of Soho to the traditional clubs in St James.

programme.title: Bulldog Drummond's Bride
programme.desc: 1939. Mystery. Directed by James P. Hogan. Stars John Howard, Heather Angel & H.B. Warner. Bulldog Drummond's wedding is interrupted once more, by a bank robbery and a daring escape.

programme.title: Stranger From Venus
programme.desc: 1954. Sci-fi. Directed by Burt Balaban. A beautifully-crafted tale. A woman (Patricia Neal) meets a man (Dantine) from Venus with no pulse to warn Earth about the atom. Also starring Derek Bond.

programme.title: Dick Tracy Vs Crime Inc.
programme.desc: 1941. Action. Directors: John English & William Witney. Stars Ralph Byrd, Michael Owen & Jan Wiley. Dick Tracy goes up against a villain known as The Ghost, who can turn himself invisible.

programme.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
programme.desc: The Clampetts Are Overdrawn. 1963. Stars Buddy Ebsen, King Donovan & Shirley Mitchell. The Clampetts receive a letter, intended for a deadbeat actor, telling them they are overdrawn.

programme.title: McLintock
programme.desc: 1963. Western. Director: Andrew V. McLaglen. Stars John Wayne, Maureen O'Hara & Patrick Wayne. Wealthy rancher McLintock uses his power and influence to keep the peace between conflicting groups.

programme.title: The First of the Few
programme.desc: 1942. War. Directed by and stars Leslie Howard. Features David Niven & Rosamund John. Aviation pioneer R.J. Mitchell struggles to develop the Spitfire fighter plane before war with Germany begins.

programme.title: BFI: Post Early for Christmas
programme.desc: 1951. Animation. This delightful silhouette animation may not be the most logical argument for helping the Post Office out, but who cares when it's so charmingly packaged.

programme.title: The Vise
programme.desc: Week-End Guest. 1955. Stars Ron Randell, Mary Hinton & Kenneth Haigh. A young reporter is sent by a London newspaper to interview a woman regarding a celebrated author.

programme.title: The Footage Detectives
programme.desc: Step back into the 70s with Mike and Noel for a wonderful reel showing the holiday of a lifetime. After this, have a hilarious peak at the Ford V8 and watch Mario Pietro in concert!

programme.title: The Guinea Pig
programme.desc: 1948. Drama. Director: Roy Boulting. Stars Richard Attenborough, Bernard Miles & Sheila Sim. Set after WW2. Jack Read, a cockney boy, becomes a guinea pig in an educational experiment.

programme.title: Memories of Making Sergeant Cork
programme.desc: Acclaimed actor William Gaunt describes how the Sergeant Cork was produced.

programme.title: Sergeant Cork
programme.desc: The Case of the Ormsby Diamonds. 1964. Stars John Barrie, William Gaunt & Edward Woodward. Diamonds are stolen from the Ormsby family, could a family member or guest have taken them?

programme.title: Who Do You Do?
programme.desc: 1972. With Freddie Starr and Peter Goodwright, guest acts Dailey & Wayne, Janet Brown and Alan Clive play a number of roles in a series of sketches and songs!

programme.title: Jekyll and Hyde (1990)
programme.desc: 1990. Thriller. Directed by David Wickes. Stars Michael Caine, Cheryl Ladd & Joss Ackland. The exciting story of Dr. Henry Jekyll, a tortured scientist whose experiments have hideous consequences.

programme.title: The Heritage Chart Show with Mike Read
programme.desc: A TOTP style TV Show for Heritage Artists based on the Heritage Chart which is voted on in over 80 countries. Songs you love from popular artists, live and on video with the odd interview.

programme.title: Element of Doubt
programme.desc: 1996. Thriller. Directed by Christopher Morahan. Stars Nigel Havers, Gina McKee & Judy Parfitt. A woman has doubts about the loyalty of her husband and suspects him of playing a deceitful game.

programme.title: Boris Karloff: The Man Behind
programme.desc: the Monster. 2021. Documentary. Directed by Thomas Hamilton. Features Ron Perlman, Guillermo del Toro. A look at the life and legacy of Boris Karloff, and the history of the genre he personified.

programme.title: A Home of Your Own
programme.desc: 1965. Comedy. Directed by Jay Lewis Stars Ronnie Barker, Peter Butterworth & Bernard Cribbins. A wordless, satirical look at British builders as they attempt to build a young couple's dream home.

programme.title: Johnny Ringo
programme.desc: Uncertain Vengeance. Directed by Aaron Spelling. When Crane's son announces his intention of riding off with his brother, she informs Ringo that her older son is a notorious criminal.

programme.title: The Cisco Kid: South of Rio Grande
programme.desc: 1945. Western. Director Lambert Hillyer. Stars Duncan Renaldo, Martin Garralaga & Armida. Cisco and Pancho infiltrate the operations of Miguel Sanches and free the district from his control.

programme.title: Dublin Nightmare
programme.desc: 1958. Thriller. Directed by John Pomeroy. Stars William Sylvester & Marla Landi. A photographer investigates the murder of his friend, which occurred during a bank robbery for The Cause.

programme.title: Early One Morning
programme.desc: 1937. Classic Swedish documentary by Gosta Roosling about an early morning Christmas service in a country church.

programme.title: Danger By My Side
programme.desc: 1963. Crime. Stars Anthony Oliver, Maureen Connell, Bill Nagy. With the help of the Met police a girl tracks down the killers of her detective brother.

programme.title: Flockton Flyer
programme.desc: Op It. 1978. Stars David Neal, Catrin Strong & Anthony Sharp. Everyone is very busy. Bob and the volunteers have freight deliveries up and down the railway (S2, E05)

programme.title: Rumpole of the Bailey
programme.desc: Rumpole and the Eternal Triangle. Stars: Leo McKern, Marion Mathie, Peter Blythe. Rumpole finds himself defending a husband on a charge for murder.

programme.title: St. Martin's Lane
programme.desc: 1938. Drama. Director: Tim Whelan. Stars Charles Laughton, Vivien Leigh & Rex Harrison. A busker works a poor girl into his act. He leads her to fame even if it means sacrificing his love for her.

programme.title: The Embezzler
programme.desc: 1954. Crime. Directed by John Gilling. Stars Charles Victor, Peggy Mount and Michael Craig. An elderly bank cashier with two years to live absconds with the contents of a bank safe.
